product.title: Half-Day Trip from Key West with Kayaking, Snorkeling & Sunset

description.text: Get ready for fun in the sun—and leave all the planning to someone else—on this half-day sailing, kayaking, and snorkeling adventure off the coast of Key West. Kayak through a maze of mangrove-canopied canals and streams, home to a tropical array of birds, rays, sharks, sport fish and more. Then jump into the water for a snorkeling session above a coral reef teeming with marine life. Ideal for travelers basing in Key West who want a guided Florida Keys experience without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
